nosotros.desc: We are a digital engineering firm specialized in sub-second web architectures, native mobile applications, and custom enterprise software with full technology ownership.

nosotros.historia_p2: Under the technical leadership of {fundador} ({universidad}), we combine enterprise engineering standards, extreme Core Web Vitals optimization, cloud security, and full Git repository ownership.
nosotros.historia_p3: We operate with contractual transparency, measurable milestone deliverables, and direct engineering support for growing companies and enterprises.
nosotros.mision_desc: Boost each client's digital competitiveness with ultra-fast, secure, and scalable proprietary software, eliminating unnecessary monthly fees and operational bottlenecks.
nosotros.vision_desc: To be the benchmark engineering firm in Latin America for sub-second web architectures and cloud/mobile solutions with full client ownership.

terminos.desc: Clear, transparent, and binding terms governing contracting, software engineering, source code handoff, and support at {marca}.

clausulas.texto: Every project begins with a formal proposal specifying architecture, modules, deliverables, timeline, and fixed budget.
items: Development starts upon written proposal approval and kickoff milestone payment.
Any additional feature outside the approved scope is quoted as a separate addendum.
Delivery timelines are counted in business days from client asset handoff.

clausulas.texto: Unlike agencies that rent templates, we guarantee total technology ownership upon final payment.
items: Full delivery of Git repository, clean source code, and master deployment credentials.
Zero forced monthly retainers or platform lock-in fees.
Client-provided brand assets, copy, and media remain exclusively yours.

clausulas.texto: We operate with full transparency in USD or PEN through formal payment channels.
items: One-time milestone payments (project kickoff and final production handoff).
Accepted methods: Bank transfer, Yape, Plin, Card, PayPal, and Cash.
Official electronic invoicing issued for every payment.

clausulas.texto: We validate quality and speed transparently throughout the entire engineering cycle.
items: Private live staging URL to test responsive layout, flows, and performance.
Up to 3 comprehensive review rounds before production deployment.
Technical optimization focused on Core Web Vitals and SEO best practices.

clausulas.texto: We stand behind every line of code delivered to ensure business continuity.
items: 30-day complimentary technical warranty covering any code-related issue.
Operational onboarding so your team can manage content independently.
Warranty does not cover third-party modifications made after handoff.

clausulas.texto: All business data, databases, and shared credentials are handled under strict confidentiality.
items: Credentials are used strictly for authorized setup, deployment, and testing.
We recommend rotating master keys after final repository handoff.

clausulas.texto: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Peru, including Consumer Protection regulations.
items: Any dispute is first addressed directly for amicable resolution.
Competent jurisdiction in the courts of Lima, Peru.

clausulas.texto: We may update these terms to reflect operational or regulatory improvements.
items: For contractual inquiries or legal notices write directly to {correo}.
In-person meetings by appointment at {sede}.

cookies.desc: At {marca}, we respect your privacy. Here is the exact list of local storage keys and cookies used to deliver an ultra-fast, secure experience.

clausulas.titulo: What are cookies and local storage?
clausulas.texto: They are small keys stored in your browser (such as LocalStorage or technical cookies) that remember your preferences without hurting speed or privacy.
We only use strictly necessary storage so the site runs smoothly: visual theme (Light/Dark), language (ES/EN/PT), currency (PEN/USD), and secure sign-in.
We never sell or share your browsing history with third-party ad networks. Your browsing remains private and direct.
You can clear or block cookies anytime from Chrome, Edge, Safari, or Firefox settings. Questions? Contact us at {correo}.

filas.proposito: Stores your visual theme preference (Light or Dark) with zero flicker.
Remembers your selected currency (PEN or USD) for quotes.
Keeps your chosen language (ES, EN, or PT) across pages.
Keeps your encrypted authentication session active if you sign in.

cookies.banner_msg: We use essential local storage to remember your theme, language, and deliver a fast, secure experience.

reclamaciones.desc: In accordance with Peruvian Consumer Protection regulations, submit your formal Claim Sheet here. Maximum response time: 15 business days.

reclamaciones.rec_desc: Dissatisfaction directly related to the contracted product or service.

reclamaciones.wa_tpl: Hello, I submitted a Virtual Claim Sheet with code {codigo}.
reclamaciones.faq_tit: Frequently Asked Questions about the Complaints Book

faq_items.q: How will I receive the official response?
faq_items.a: Our formal response is sent directly to the email address you entered in Step 01 from our official address ({correo}), referencing your unique HR-YYYY-XXXX code and resolution.

faq_items.q: How do I know my Claim Sheet was successfully recorded?
faq_items.a: Upon completing Step 05, your HR-YYYY-XXXX code is securely stored in our database. You can also print/save a PDF copy or send a WhatsApp confirmation immediately.

faq_items.q: How long does it take to receive a reply?
faq_items.a: Under INDECOPI Law N° 31435, the provider must issue an official response within a maximum non-extendable period of 15 business days.

faq_items.q: What is the difference between a Claim and a Complaint?
faq_items.a: A Claim relates directly to dissatisfaction with the contracted product or service. A Complaint refers to dissatisfaction with customer service, unrelated to the product itself.

faq_items.q: Can I follow up or send additional evidence?
faq_items.a: Yes. You can email {correo} or message our direct channel referencing your HR-YYYY-XXXX code to attach screenshots or supporting documents.
